description: AI-powered HIPAA compliance officer for healthcare practices. 73-tool scanning, SRA, BAA generation, breach monitoring, and audit trails. NPI is the universal key.

rawRecord.description: AI-powered HIPAA compliance officer for healthcare practices. 73-tool scanning, SRA, BAA generation, breach monitoring, and audit trails. NPI is the universal key.

detail.description: AI-powered HIPAA compliance officer for healthcare practices. 73-tool scanning, SRA, BAA generation, breach monitoring, and audit trails. NPI is the universal key.

tools.name: scan_practice
tools.description: Trigger a fresh HIPAA compliance scan for a healthcare practice. Always dispatches a new 70+ control scan via VPS — never returns cached results. Returns a job_id for polling via get_scan_status. Optionally specify notification_email to receive the PDF report when the scan completes. Cost: 150 credits.

domain.description: Practice website domain (e.g. exampleclinic.com). If omitted, looked up from existing scan data.

notification_email.description: Email address to send the completed PDF report to.

tools.name: batch_scan
tools.description: Dispatch fresh HIPAA compliance scans for multiple practices at once. Each practice costs 150 credits. If insufficient credits for the full batch, the entire request is rejected. Max 50 practices per call.

notification_email.description: Email to send the completed report to

tools.name: get_scan_status
tools.description: Check the status of the latest scan for a practice. Returns grade, scan date, and whether data is available. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_compliance_score
tools.description: Get the HIPAA Agent Compliance Score breakdown for a practice. Returns overall grade, numerical score, and per-category scores across 10 compliance categories. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Get the full compliance report for a practice including all findings, severity breakdown, grade, and HIPAA section citations. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_audit_log
tools.description: Retrieve the SHA-256 hash chain audit trail for a practice. Returns timestamped, tamper-evident log entries for all compliance actions. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_evidence_package
tools.description: Compile a 10-component evidence package for auditors and insurers. Includes scan results, policy attestations, training records, BAA ledger, and audit trail. Async — returns job_id. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: generate_baa
tools.description: Generate a Business Associate Agreement for a vendor. Requires active subscription or platform/MSP key. Cost: 25 credits.

vendor_name.description: Name of the business associate / vendor

vendor_email.description: Vendor email — if provided, the BAA is sent for signing

services_description.description: Description of services the vendor provides that involve PHI

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Get HIPAA policy documents generated for a practice. Requires active subscription or platform/MSP key. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: generate_sra
tools.description: Initiate a HIPAA Security Risk Assessment. Returns the first batch of questions for the respondent to answer. Requires active subscription or platform/MSP key. Cost: 500 credits.

practice_name.description: Practice name (auto-looked up from scan data if omitted)

respondent_name.description: Full name of the person completing the SRA

respondent_role.description: Role/title of the respondent (e.g. Practice Manager, HIPAA Officer)

respondent_email.description: Email of the person completing the SRA

tools.name: get_breach
tools.description: Check if a practice has been involved in any known HIPAA breaches reported to HHS. Matches by practice name and state. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_breach_score
tools.description: Calculate a breach exposure risk score for a practice based on breach history, breached credentials, and industry benchmarks. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: trigger_internal_scan
tools.description: Generate a deploy token for the internal network scanner agent. Returns an API key and installation instructions for deploying the agent inside a practice network. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_internal_scan_status
tools.description: Check the status of the internal network scan agent deployment and whether results have been received. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_internal_findings
tools.description: Get the latest internal network scan results including encryption status, MFA compliance, network segmentation, patch levels, and endpoint security. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: lookup_practice
tools.description: Look up a healthcare practice by NPI number. Always fetches from the NPPES registry and augments with HIPAA Agent scan data if available. Returns provider name, specialty, address, and compliance grade. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_outreach_status
tools.description: Get the outreach and drip campaign status for a practice. Returns email send history, drip stage, and engagement data. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_practice_summary
tools.description: Get a comprehensive summary of a practice combining scan results, compliance score, findings count, breach history, and internal scan status. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_training_status
tools.description: Get staff training completion records for a practice. Returns staff members and their training course completions including scores and dates. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_vendor_baa_list
tools.description: Get vendor Business Associate Agreement tracking records for a practice. Returns all vendor BAAs with status, dates, and contact info. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: log_incident
tools.description: Log a HIPAA security or privacy incident for a practice. Creates an incident report with type, description, and severity. Returns the incident ID for tracking. Cost: 25 credits.

severity.description: Severity level: low, medium, high, critical (default: medium)

incident_type.description: Type of incident: breach, unauthorized_access, device_loss, phishing, policy_violation, system_failure, other

tools.name: get_incidents
tools.description: Get incident history for a practice. Returns all logged security and privacy incidents with status, severity, and resolution dates. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_compliance_delta
tools.description: Get compliance controls that changed status since a given date. Shows improved and regressed controls with before/after comparison. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: check_vendor
tools.description: Check vendor risk profile including breach history, BAA coverage, and security score. Input vendor_name or domain. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_compliance_state
tools.description: Get the HIPAA compliance readiness state for a practice. Tracks 13 requirements against the May 2026 deadline. Returns state (compliant/near_compliant/in_progress/early_stage/not_started), completed count, next action, and per-requirement status. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: subscribe_webhook
tools.description: Register a webhook URL to receive HIPAA compliance event notifications. Events: breach_detected, score_dropped, baa_expiring, scan_completed, control_failed, sra_expired. Payloads signed with HMAC-SHA256. Cost: 25 credits.

url.description: HTTPS URL to receive webhook POST payloads

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List active webhook subscriptions for a practice. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_breach_probability
tools.description: Calculate breach probability for a practice. Model: HHS base rate by specialty, adjusted by security grade penalty, gap penalties (no MFA +8%, no encryption +12%, flat network +15%, no backups +10%), and prior breach history 3x multiplier. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: validate_workflow
tools.description: Validate whether a data workflow is HIPAA-compliant. Synchronous guardrail — returns allowed/denied with risk score, missing controls, and HIPAA citations. No prior scan required. Zero PHI. Cost: 25 credits.

data_type.description: Data classification: phi, de_identified, limited_data_set, non_phi

destination.description: Target: cloud_us, cloud_intl, on_prem, vendor, email, fax, portal

workflow_type.description: Type: data_transfer, cloud_migration, vendor_share, backup, messaging

controls_applied.description: Controls already in place (e.g. encryption_in_transit, baa, mfa)

tools.name: get_controls
tools.description: Get HIPAA/NIST control-level assessment for a practice. Maps scan findings to 13 standardized controls with pass/fail/partial status, risk scores, and required actions. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: execute_agent_baa
tools.description: Execute a digital Business Associate Agreement between two healthcare practices. Verifies both parties have passing compliance grades (C or above), creates a signed BAA with SHA-256 digital signature, and logs to the audit trail. Cost: 25 credits.

expiration_date.description: BAA expiration date (ISO 8601, default: 1 year from today)

services_description.description: Description of services involving PHI (default: Healthcare data processing services)

tools.name: get_model_insights
tools.description: Get HIPAA Agent data intelligence model stats — vulnerability patterns discovered, remediation effectiveness tracking, breach calibration coefficients, specialty benchmarks, and state coverage. Cost: 25 credits.

tools.name: get_state_coverage
tools.description: Get scanning coverage by US state — total NPIs in registry, scanned count, average grade per state. Shows which states have been expanded and their scan progress. Cost: 25 credits.

state.description: Filter to a specific 2-letter state code (e.g., CA, TX). Omit for all states.

tools.name: get_threat_intel
tools.description: Get recent healthcare threat intelligence alerts from FBI Watchdog, HHS HC3, CISA KEV, and MS-ISAC. Returns alerts with severity, healthcare relevance scores, and source attribution. Cost: 25 credits.

source.description: Filter by source: FBI_Watchdog, HHS_HC3, CISA_KEV, MS_ISAC

severity.description: Filter by severity: critical, high, medium, low

tools.name: get_reputation
tools.description: Get HIPAA Agent verified reputation stats — total scans, unique practices, documents generated, breaches tracked, uptime, and SHA-256 data integrity hash. Free, no authentication required.

tools.name: get_blockchain_anchor
tools.description: Get the blockchain anchor proof for a specific date. Returns the SHA-256 root hash of all audit events from that date, the Base L2 transaction hash, and a Basescan verification link. Proves compliance records have not been tampered with. Free, no authentication required.
